title: The Mob Accountant Who Kept a Ledger of 47 Murders—In Plain Sight
hook: He recorded every hit like a business expense, and when the IRS found it, they didn't call the cops—they called it 'tax evasion.'
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity of a killer using bookkeeping logic triggers morbid curiosity and the 'hidden in plain sight' storytelling is highly shareable.

title: The Heist Where Thieves Stole a Diamond by Replacing It With a Deadly Insect

why_this_can_go_viral: Animals in heists are rare and shocking—combining danger with clever deception is irresistible clickbait.

why_this_can_go_viral: Lunar mythology + serial killer psychology = a dark mystery that begs for a solution. The puzzle element drives comments and shares.
